outcome_evidence: The robot approaches and aligns with the drawer handle in frames 0–75, then closes its gripper around it in frames 76–81 (wrist_image). It pulls the drawer outward in frames 94–119, exposing the drawer sides and interior (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image). In frames 122–125 it releases the handle, leaving the drawer visibly open (image, left_ego_image). No failed acquisition, harmful collision, or unintended object displacement is visible.
